biography.value:
Published alignment: N/LN.

Description

This wyrmling wingless dragon has rocky scales with two large horns. Brown dragons usually live in caves or underground.

Defense

AC 21, touch 12, flat-footed 20 (+1 dex, +9 natural, +1 size)

hp 83 (7d12+35)

mp 21

Fort +9, Ref +8, Will +7

Immune Earth, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Lightning 50%

Weakness Wind

Offense

Speed 60 ft., burrow 40 ft.

Melee Bite +13 (1d6+7), 2 Claws +13 (1d4+5)

Space 2.5 ft.; Reach 0 ft. (5 ft. with bite)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (40-ft. line, 2d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 17 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Mud Gun, Slow Breath (20-ft. cone, DC 17)

Special Abilities Triumphant Roar

Spells Known (FC CL 7th, Concentration +10)

At will - detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 14) - pass without trace, stone fist

2nd (DC 15) - binding earth, elemental resistance, groundswell, soften earth and stone, stone call, wall climb

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 12, Con 18, Int 7, Wis 16, Cha 10

Base Atk +7; CMB +11; CMD 22 (26 vs. trip)

Feats Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Bluff +10, Climb +19, Intimidate +10, Perception +13, Stealth +19; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth

Languages Draconic

SQ Earth glide

ffd20-bestiary-builder.sourceText: Breath Weapon (40-ft. line, 2d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 17 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)

description.value: As a standard action, a brown dragon can shoot mud out of its mouth towards a single target with an earth projectile. The brown dragon must make a ranged touch attack (+9), if it hits, the attack deals 1d6+2 earth damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 16) or be inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 17).

effect: Single earth projectile; 30-foot range as Mud Gun spell; Weighted only on failed Fortitude.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 17).

description.value: Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, the brown dragon releases a raging fierce roar, boosting their personal attack power. This adds a +6 morale bonus to all attack rolls for seven rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).
